svg.title: Held-out Dice–HD95 trade-offs
svg.desc: Regional held-out Dice versus mean HD95 for the 11-model publication comparison.
svg.text: 11-model publication comparison; magnified Dice axis: 0.70–0.90; frozen aggregate values only.
Small dots mark exact coordinates; numbered callouts are offset with leader lines. Magnified Dice scale is declared; values are descriptive.
